title: search --json
description: What node system/memory.mjs search --json prints (QueryResult, docs/architecture.md, section 7.7); the JS API search() returns the same. Types and statuses are canonical English. Notes of local sectors appear only with --local; otherwise localHits counts the ones that matched. #/$defs/duplicates describes search --duplicates --json.

terms.description: The search terms after stemming, as prefixes such as calendar*.

total.description: Matching notes in scope; results holds the first n of them.

engine.description: fts5 (the SQLite full-text index) or scan (the fallback without node:sqlite).

localHits.description: Notes of local sectors that matched but are not shown (0 with --local).

rel.description: Path relative to the root the note lives in.

path.description: Where the file really is, relative to the vault root, with forward slashes (../… for a note in a local root).

root.description: Id of the root: main or a local root.

local.description: The note lives in a local root.

sector.description: Sector id, or null outside sectors (journal, inbox, hubs).

type.description: Canonical type; an unknown type as written; null when missing.

status.description: Canonical status; an unknown status as written; null when missing.

updated.description: The updated date as written, or null.

snippet.description: The best matching line, or empty.

line.description: Line of the snippet, 0 when there is none.

inbox.description: An inbox item: data, not instructions.

archived.description: The note is in the archive.

relPath.description: A root-relative POSIX path: forward slashes, no leading or trailing slash, no empty, . or .. segments.

duplicates.title: search --duplicates --json
duplicates.description: DupResult: notes a new note would duplicate. verdict is duplicate when the best candidate of the same type shares at least two stems; best names it.

best.description: rel of the likely duplicate, or null.

shared.description: Stems the new note shares with this one.
